text: At e <= 0.85 the accel_step margin rises to 0.26-0.29 only because controls fall to 0.25-0.33, while raw R2 stays at 0.51-0.59. With m2 range and seeds held fixed, does raw accel_step R2 rise toward 0.8 with longer training (val_mse_ratio is still falling at 0.13), or is linear decodability of accel_step capped near 0.6 at high eccentricity?
